• </span><span class="" style="font-weight: 700;">High-quality video</span><span class="" style="">: Get enhanced bitrate 1080p for extra crisp and clear videos with lots of detail and motion

• </span><span class="" style="font-weight: 700;">Smart downloads</span><span class="" style="">: Get recommended videos automatically added to your downloads for offline viewing
• </span><span class="" style="font-weight: 700;">Queuing</span><span class="" style="">: Set up videos to watch next without interrupting your current watch session</span></span></div></div></div></div></faq-entry-view-model><faq-entry-view-model><div class="ytLpFaqEntryViewModelHost"><div class="ytLpFaqEntryViewModelFaqQuestionAndAnswersSection" role="button" aria-labelledby="faq-question-and-answers-section-question:3" tab-index="0" aria-expanded="false"><div class="ytLpFaqEntryViewModelLpFaqSectionFaqsQuestion" aria-hidden="true"><h2 class="ytLpFaqEntryViewModelLpFaqQuestion" id="faq-question-and-answers-section-question:3"><span class="ytAttributedStringHost ytAttributedStringWhiteSpacePreWrap" role="text" style=""><span class="" style="">What's included with YouTube Premium Lite?</span></span></h2></div><div class="ytLpFaqEntryViewModelIconContainer"><span class="ytIconWrapperHost" aria-hidden="true"><span class="yt-icon-shape ytSpecIconShapeHost"><div style="width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; fill: currentcolor;"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" height="24" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="24" focusable="false" aria-hidden="true" style="pointer-events: none; display: inherit; width: 100%; height: 100%;"><path d="M18.707 8.793a1 1 0 00-1.414 0L12 14.086 6.707 8.793a1 1 0 10-1.414 1.414L12 16.914l6.707-6.707a1 1 0 000-1.414Z"></path></svg></div></span></span><div class="ytLpFaqEntryViewModelIconHoverHighlighting"></div></div></div><div class="ytLpFaqEntryViewModelLpFaqSectionFaqsOuterAnswer ytLpFaqEntryViewModelLpFaqSectionFaqsOuterAnswerCollapsed"><div id="faq-container:2"><div class="ytLpFaqEntryViewModelLpFaqSectionFaqsAnswer"><span class="ytAttributedStringHost ytAttributedStringWhiteSpacePreWrap" style=""><span class="" style="">Premium Lite benefits (background play, downloads, ad-free) available on most non-music content, excluding Shorts.
